event.description: Shrink MQA transformer width from d16 to d14
event.proposal: family: attention organization; retained incumbent is 3584 parameters at 99.1700%, a +0.17 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family accepted result: attempt-0015, d16 MQA at 3776/99.95%; same-family failed result: attempt-0018, d16 rank-6 output projection at 3648/0.01% (with attempts 0016–0017 also failing); prior attempts in this family: 4. Hypothesis: preserve two independently scored attention heads and the successful shared-K/V organization while shrinking each head channel from 8 to 7 (d14), with ff17 and learned positions unchanged; the actual model should be 2992 parameters. This is more informative than one-head deletion because it isolates channel width while retaining two-head attention and independent depth. Keep the mixed-digit curriculum and 30000-step training; retain only official accuracy >=99% and strictly below 3584 parameters.
